other_conditions: Must be a destitute tribal bride or an individual who is disabled, destitute, elderly, blind, or extremely destitute.
Must hold a valid caste certificate confirming Scheduled Tribe status.
benefits_summary: Cash relief of up to ₹15,000 for house burning and ₹5,000 for loss of livelihood, damages to wells, tube wells, motors, or other economic resources.
documents_required: Caste certificate confirming Scheduled Tribe status
